Donald Trump delivered remarks in Doral, Florida, last night, to House
Republicans during their retreat, and then as part of a press conference. It
might not seem like an appropriate time to be off the job, but, dear reader,
based on Trump's remarks, maybe it's better if he steps away from the steering
wheel. Let's discuss, debunk, annotate, and report on his insanity - quote by
quote:

**First off, there were so** _**many**_**lies:**

**["Try finding wind farms in
China."](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2031116714147197176?s=20)**

China is the [leading
producer](https://wwindea.org/GlobalStatistics#:~:text=Here%20are%20some%20statistics%20on%20wind%20power,of%20wind%20power%20above%20the%20world%20average)
of wind energy in the world.

**["[Democrats] don't say [affordability] anymore because we brought down
prices."](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2031117043328766087?s=20)**

Voters strongly disapprove of Trump's handling of the economy - to a record
degree, according to a new Quinnipiac [poll](https://poll.qu.edu/poll-
release?releaseid=3952). Prices are only getting higher as a result of Trump's
illegal war in Iran.

**["Virtually nobody has a system of mail-in ballots like we have; no other
country in the world.](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2031132481504817201?s=20)**"

[Dozens of nations](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/fact-checking-
trumps-claim-the-u-s-is-the-only-country-that-uses-mail-in-voting) have some
form of mail-in voting.

**[Iran"was looking to take over the Middle
East."](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2031115859683598416?s=20)**

There's only one nation in the Middle East right now seeking to encroach on
neighboring territories: Israel.

**["If we didn't go in, they would have come in after
us."](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2031116238936752259?s=20)**

Once again, there was no proof that Iran posed any "imminent threat" to the
US, and, in fact, the country was negotiating a new nuclear deal with the
Trump administration before the president decided to attack.

**["…the Tomahawk is sold and used by other countries…Iran who also has some
Tomahawks."](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2031131478617444468)**

Trump has continued to suggest that Iran was responsible for the horrific
bombing of an Iranian girls' school, killing some 175 people, mostly children.
Repeated independent reporting has found that the US was likely the culprit.
Footage shows that it was a Tomahawk missile that rained down on the school -
a US munition that Iran _does not possess._
